ns2:section.sectionText: Title: Writing and Screening Post-colonial North Africa Dr. Kamal Salhi, the instructor of this course plans to teach this course in French, but students not in the Department of French and who do not read or write in French will be allowed to read the course materials in English, write their papers in English, and participate orally in class in English. All students will, however, be expected to understand spoken French enough to follow the instruction and participation by other students.
